entries.summary: Hot locations are now organized by country and city with checkboxes so you can enable only the places you need.
'Walk via roads' is now available directly in the floating widget map.
The tap marker stays on the map after you dismiss the action sheet, so you can reposition before acting.
The app can now open coordinates sent via 'geo:' links from other apps and tools.
Added 6 Chicago hot locations and per-location selection.
